input.overview: Shoppers using io-shop found that their account pages loaded slowly for {duration}. A configuration change pointed the shop at a cache address that refused its connections, so account pages had to be built from scratch every time they were requested. The pages still showed the right information, but they took longer to appear. Argus estimates the cost to the shop in lost takings at {customer_loss}. Nobody was paged, and no on-call incident was linked to this one, so no responders were called in. Argus ended the incident by rolling back the io-shop deployment. The rollback is confirmed and still in place, and automatic sync has been left off. Argus has also proposed a permanent fix, which is open as a draft pull request and has not yet been applied.
